title: processkit item provenance
description: The member status.provenance of a served item (ontology@v1 schemas/status.schema.json; inheritance@v1 PK-INH-015, PK-INH-055). status.references[].origin has the shape of $defs/location.

origin.description: Where the item comes from: the repository that first provides it. For an overridden inherited item this is the overridden upstream item, not the override.

overrides.description: Every override applied on the way from the origin to the served item, in the order applied (nearest to the origin first). Empty when no override applied.

restricted.description: True when the repository that provides the item marked it restricted (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-061).

restrictedBy.description: Present when restricted is true: the lock entry name of the repository that marked the item restricted. Its access rules must be imported (PK-INH-031).

upstream.description: Lock entry name of the repository (for example platform or platform/company); null for the serving repository.

source.description: The lock entry's source; null for the serving repository.

commit.description: The locked commit for an upstream; for the serving repository the working-copy commit (repository-storage@v1 revision.commit), null before the first commit.

path.description: POSIX path of the file that holds the item's envelope, relative to the root of that repository.

upstream.description: spec.overrides.upstream of the overriding item, as written there.

effect.description: spec.overrides.effect of the overriding item (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-051).

stale.description: True when the override is stale (inheritance@v1 PK-INH-053).
